newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Apr commodity futures volume falls 30.8% y/y.
newsitem.headline: Japan Apr commodity futures volume falls 30.8% y/y.

text.p: Futures trading volume on Japan's nine commodity exchanges totalled 5,752,561 lots in April, down 30.8 percent from the same month a year ago and down 10.3 percent from March, the Japan Federation of Commodity Exchanges said on Thursday.
Rubber, corn and red bean futures were among the decliners from April 1996, while trading volume in platinum and palladium futures increased sharply from the previous year, the federation said.

"A prolonged suspension of Russian exports of platinum group metals to Japan continued to boost speculative interest, especially in palladium futures," a federation official said. "In grain futures, private investors were tending to pour money into more volatile soybean futures after closing positions in red beans and corn futures," the official said.
